title: Evidence
description: A machine-checkable claim bundle produced when a capability is exercised inside a Session: schema validity, test outcome, and sha256 hashes of the produced artifacts.

evidence_id.description: Unique identifier for this evidence bundle.

session_id.description: session_id of the Session under which the work was performed.

capability_id.description: Capability.id of the capability that was exercised.

schema_valid.description: True iff the produced output validated against the capability's output_schema.

tests_passed.description: True iff the acceptance tests for the task passed.

artifact_hashes.description: Map of artifact filename to lowercase hex sha256 digest of its content. May be empty if the task produced no file artifacts, but the field itself is REQUIRED.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp at which the evidence was produced.

extensions.description: Open bag for vendor or profile extensions. Keys SHOULD be namespaced (e.g. 'vendor.example/field').
